answer: The zenith of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, revoked by a single upheld challenge, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The pigment is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the falcon.
